facts.label: Facility overview
facts.value: RNP’s Pernambuco point of presence and network operations centre are hosted at ITEP in Recife. This is an academic network node; commercial colocation capacity is not established by the source.

facts.label: Research network connectivity
facts.value: The PoP connects institutions through regional networks including Redecomep Recife, RedeVASF and RePEPE; no site-specific port capacity is published here.
